_comment: Uncork compatibility profiles: the Mac analog of Steam-on-Linux's per-game Proton-version picker. A profile is a matched bundle of (Wine engine + graphics backend), because on Apple Silicon the two are ABI-coupled (D3DMetal is locked to GPTk Wine; DXMT's winemetal.so is locked to its Wine build). Users pick a profile per game; play.sh maps profile to backend (engine follows from backend). Read by scripts/compatdb.sh and the app (CompatProfiles.swift). Data-driven: updates without rebuilding the app.
_schema: profiles: { id: { label, backend(d3dmetal|dxmt|dxvk), bundled(bool), summary, best_for, warn(optional), engine_id(d3dmetal downloadable engines), download(url) } }. 'auto' resolves at launch (GPTk+D3DMetal if installed, else Wine11+DXMT). engine_id/download drive scripts/ensure-profile.sh (Steam-style 'download an engine version').

auto.label: Automatic (recommended)
auto.summary: Let Uncork choose the best engine for this game.
auto.best_for: Most games - picks Game Porting Toolkit + D3DMetal when available, otherwise Wine 11 + DXMT.

gptk.label: Game Porting Toolkit (D3D11/12)
gptk.summary: Apple's D3DMetal on GPTk Wine: DirectX 11/12 straight to Metal.
gptk.best_for: Modern 64-bit games (most AAA + Unity/Unreal D3D11/12 titles).

gptk-2.1.label: Game Porting Toolkit 2.1 (older D3DMetal)
gptk-2.1.summary: An older D3DMetal + Wine, in its own bottle.
gptk-2.1.best_for: Try if a game regressed on the current GPTk - the Mac version of 'roll back the Proton version'.
gptk-2.1.warn: Older D3DMetal - may not run on the newest macOS; use only if the current profile fails.

gptk-1.1.label: Game Porting Toolkit 1.1 (oldest D3DMetal)
gptk-1.1.summary: The original D3DMetal + Wine 7.7, in its own bottle.
gptk-1.1.best_for: Last resort for older games that only worked on early GPTk.
gptk-1.1.warn: Oldest D3DMetal - likely won't run on recent macOS; try only if everything else fails.

wine11-dxmt.label: Wine 11 + DXMT
wine11-dxmt.summary: DXMT (DirectX 11 to Metal) on the bundled Wine 11 + the Steam client.
wine11-dxmt.best_for: D3D11 games that misbehave on D3DMetal, or that need the live Steam client (SteamStub DRM).

wine11-dxvk.label: Wine 11 + DXVK
wine11-dxvk.summary: DXVK (DirectX 9/10/11 to Vulkan to Metal via MoltenVK).
wine11-dxvk.warn: On Apple Silicon MoltenVK lacks the geometryShader feature DXVK requires, so this often can't get a GPU - try it, but D3DMetal/DXMT are usually the working choices.

_engine_note: engine ids reference wine-fixes/engines.json; CEF launchers (Ubisoft/EA) map to uncork-* engines via engines.json "suits" + their launch scripts
